notes: Expected values come from a forward-only oracle plus central finite differences (h=1e-5); the reference's exact gradients agree with them to 2.2e-8 worst case over all 191 programs (gate 1e-6). wrong_unbroadcast sums broadcast grads over leading axes only (fails the (B,1)-(B,C) keepdims probe); wrong_naive_lse has no max shift in logsumexp (OverflowError on the |logit|~900 cases); wrong_recursive builds the topological order recursively (RecursionError on the 20000-op chain only); wrong_stale_grad keeps intermediate grads on the nodes across backward() calls (first trips on the two-root reduction probe, case 12, then every multi-root program); wrong_no_zero_grad accumulates parameter grads across SGD steps (step 1 still uses clean grads; the trace diverges at step 2); wrong_matmul_vec keeps the axis inserted for a rank-1 matmul operand. slow.py finds each node's consumers by scanning all nodes (quadratic): killed by the validator's own 10 s limit on the chain. The reference runs the whole hidden set in about 1 s.
